Name: Glenita Montgomery
Badge: Everyday Sparks 2.0
Which strategy from this module (Daily Schedule, Take a Line for a Walk or Interpreting Visual Texts) feels most immediately usable in your teaching context? Why?:

I feel like the Interpreting Visual Texts was easy to utilize within my mathematics instruction. We have been looking at a variety of visuals, graphs, charts, tables, etc.

What other strategies or approaches have you used to engage your students in routine writing over the course of this school year? What, if any, challenges have you encountered in engaging students in sustained routine writing?:
I try to have my students write about steps for solving word problems or work with vocabulary for each topic. Since we have such a high number of ELLS in our district, I feel like the language aspect was very important to address.
